source.title: Western lowland gorilla
source.quote: Males have an average weight of 140 kg (310 lb), females of 70 kg (150 lb).

mass_kg.note: Average adult male, from the lowland article; the Western gorilla article gives 145-191 kg for males, so this is the lower, lowland-specific figure. Range is the standard +/-10%.

source.title: Western gorilla
source.quote: Males average 1.67 m (5.5 ft) although reaching a height up to 1.76 m (5.8 ft)

size_m.note: Average standing height of adult males. High is the stated maximum in the same sentence; low is the standard -10%.

top_speed_mps.note: No published top speed found for this animal; category default.

source.title: 9 mammals, sharks, and reptiles with the strongest bite (IFAW)
source.quote: The bite force of the Western gorilla (Gorilla gorilla) was calculated by one study to be about 3,420 Newtons.
source.license: Publisher copyright, not an open license; one sentence cited

attack_force_n.note: Modeled maximum molar bite from Eng, Lieberman, Zink and Peters 2013, Am. J. Phys. Anthropol. 151:544 (doi:10.1002/ajpa.22296), as quoted by IFAW. Second-hand: the paper's PDF could not be opened. A molar, not canine, bite, so it is not directly comparable with the Wroe canine values on the wolf and grizzly sheets (593 N and 751 N); it is about 3 times the code's carnivore fit for 140 kg (1,016 N) and high for a fighting bite. Range is +/-50%, as on the elephant's stand-in.

attacks_per_s.note: No published attack rate found for this animal; category default.

armor_0_1.note: armor level 1: fur and bare skin.

source.title: Observations of severe and lethal coalitionary attacks in wild mountain gorillas (Rosenbaum, Vecellio and Stoinski 2016, Scientific Reports 6:37018)
source.quote: Approximately 3-4 minutes after the attack began, it abruptly stopped.

endurance_s.note: Stand-in, not a measured endurance: one 2004 attack by 26 mountain gorillas on a lone male, which the attackers stopped on their own after 3-4 minutes (the same paper reports another attack of 18 minutes). Used for an adult male western lowland gorilla. Upper end of the stated range; the source gives no mean.

aggression_0_1.note: aggression level 3: defends itself and its troop, avoids risky fights.

group_tactics_0_1.note: group tactics level 3: family troop that defends together.
